# Family Crests

Family crests: design a family crest or coat of arms with your surname and motto, and the symbols and colors you choose, for gifts, reunions, prints and engravings.

## What it does
Give the surname, the motto, the symbols and the colors. Claude tells you the price and designs the crest with your words on it.

**How the files are made:** each family crest is generated by an image model. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

The lettering is drawn by the model, so check it in the result.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install family-crests@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Family Crests talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/family-crest/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each family crest uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The family crests show in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_family_crest_models` | Models for family crests with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_family_crest_cost` | Exact price of one family crest before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_family_crest` | Starts one family crest in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_family_crest` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "Design a family crest for the O'Brien family with a lion"
- "Make a coat of arms for the Rossi family in blue and gold"
- "Create a modern family crest with the motto Strength and Honor"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the family crest (the surname, motto, symbols, colors and style) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
